card.name: Word just before an expected ending
card.fires_on: A word or word piece that is complete or nearly complete and is followed by a closing piece like -ly, -day or -ward. Seen in IMMEDIATELY, "some day", month names before a date, and weekday names after a person.

modes.label: Stem before -ly
modes.description: The middle of a long adverb such as IMMEDIATELY, where an -ly ending comes next.
modes.example: CALL YOUR HEALTHCARE PROVIDER IMM<<EDIATE>>LY IF YOU THINK YOU MAY HAVE A

modes.label: Date and day words
modes.description: A month or weekday name placed right before a day number or after an event.
modes.example: The Geography of Young People Morally Contested Spaces Published<< July>> 5th 2001

modes.label: Short words before a noun
modes.description: Words like one, some or direct that sit after a noun and before a time or place word.
modes.example: You could be on the development side<< some>> day.

card.writes: It promotes adverb endings like -edly, -ely, -ously and -ively, so it favors finishing an adverb.
card.plain: It fires on a word that is likely to be followed by an ending such as -ly, as in immediately, and on date words.
